name: archboard_workhorse
description: Work with your workhorses, the agents that do sustained work for this Archboard server. There is one workhorse for each checkout, and it works in that checkout. Every tool but stop_workhorses takes checkout: the directory of the checkout, the repository in your board context. Called from a script, a tool resolves to one string of JSON holding its whole result: print it with text(result). It is not an object, and it has no content array.

tools.name: inspect_workhorse
tools.description: Read what the workhorse of one checkout is doing now: whether a turn is running, what is waiting for it, and its recent progress. Returns at once.

tools.name: delegate_to_workhorse
tools.description: Give the workhorse of one checkout one piece of sustained work, written in English with the conversation context it needs. If that checkout has no workhorse yet, this starts one.

tools.name: manage_workhorse_queue
tools.description: See or change the requests waiting for the workhorse of one checkout to finish what it is doing.

tools.name: steer_workhorse
tools.description: Add one short instruction, such as a correction, to the turn the workhorse of one checkout is running now. Works only while a turn is running.

tools.name: stop_workhorses
tools.description: Stop every running workhorse of this conversation, in every checkout, when the person asks to stop. Returns at once with one entry for each workhorse: interrupt_sent when a stop was sent to its running turn, idle when it had none. A sent interrupt is not proof that work stopped: the work has stopped only once workhorse news says its turn ended.
